Give this one a miss…
Aug 2023 • Couples
This is the worse German food I’ve had! I had to send back my food. In fact, the smell was so horrid, I asked for it to be taken away! The fried sausage smelt like it was terribly off and tasted just as bad. The cabbage was bland. The salmon and asparagus salad was anything but fresh. The apple strudel was the smallest I’ve seen with its very thick layer of filo pastry. This was way too sickening to eat. (I spat out the very first bite!). All you could taste was this floury hard tasteless whatever…. 

Not to mention having to walk through a thick wall of cigarette smoke from the Vietnamese patrons sitting at the bar at the entrance of the restaurant from where you are led to the seating area at the back of the restaurant. 

While they had enough staff, they seemed to be very attentive to the Vietnamese patrons, but not to foreigners.

If eating food that have been left out to rot then refried or double-cooked is your thing, and you have no idea what authentic German food tastes like, this is your place! 

I would NOT recommend this place, and will never go there again! 

For AUTHENTIC German food, go to PARKHAUS in D1 - it may be small but at least the CHEF IS GERMAN and cooks FRESH(!!) German food.

Alles hat ein Ende, nur die Wurst hat zwei
Aug 2019
The restaurant was in walking distance to our hotel. As you enter the venue the bar is directly in front. It was quite busy st the bar area and a lot of people smoking. This was really off putting. The food and drinks however were top notch. A great selection of German dishes and platters and a great assortment of beers, schnapps and many other drinks on offer. 

We had the platter for 4 pax and it was fantastic. It had some sausages, meat loaf, potatoes, schweinhaxen. Everything was well cooked and delicious. We also ordered a chicken schnitzel. The schnitzel was probably the best we have ever had in Asia! The service was also good - a strong team running the restaurant.
